description: This file defines a Python module that provides a class 'LLMContext' for managing conversation context, messages, and multimedia content (images, audio) for Large Language Model (LLM) interactions within the Pipecat framework. It includes methods for creating, manipulating, and retrieving messages, handling media encoding, and integrating with specific LLM services via adapters. The code also handles conversion from OpenAI-specific contexts to a universal format.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Manages conversation context, including message history, multimedia content, tools, and tool choice for LLM interactions within the Pipecat framework. Provides methods to add, set, filter messages, and create media messages asynchronously.
